evals.prompt: Write technical specifications for checkout retry. Supplied facts: maximum 3 retries with exponential backoff; requests are idempotent on order_id; a duplicate idempotency key returns HTTP 409 Conflict. Use distinct neutral unpadded rows following RETRY|<operation>|<count>|<unit>|<strategy>, IDEMPOTENCY|<operation>|<key>|<duplicate-key behavior>, and RESPONSE|<condition>|<HTTP status>|<outcome>.
evals.expected_output:
Preserve the retry count and strategy, order_id idempotency key, and HTTP 409 Conflict duplicate-key outcome:
RETRY|checkout|3|retries|exponential backoff
IDEMPOTENCY|checkout|order_id|duplicate key returns HTTP 409 Conflict
RESPONSE|duplicate idempotency key|HTTP 409|Conflict

evals.prompt: Create technical requirements for API timeout fallback. Supplied facts: the gateway timeout threshold is 2500ms; when that timeout occurs, use cached inventory and emit a warning log event. Use distinct neutral unpadded rows following TRIGGER|<source>|<condition>|<threshold>|<unit>, ACTION|<condition>|<fallback behavior>, and EVENT|<condition>|<event>|<emission behavior>.
evals.expected_output:
Bind the 2500ms gateway timeout to cached-inventory fallback and warning-event emission:
TRIGGER|gateway|timeout|2500|ms
ACTION|timeout|cached inventory fallback
EVENT|timeout|warning log event|emitted

evals.prompt: Design technical implementation for order cancellation. Controlled facts: no behavioral acceptance criteria exist and implementation prerequisites have not been verified. Can engineering proceed with development? Use neutral unpadded rows following READINESS|<decision subject>|<verdict>|<authorization>|<basis> and NEXT|<subject>|<gate>|<required prerequisites>|<destination>.
evals.expected_output:
Do not authorize implementation. Record the affected slice as not ready because behavioral acceptance criteria and verified prerequisites are absent; route to requirements/planning before development:
READINESS|order cancellation implementation|NOT READY|NOT AUTHORIZED|behavioral acceptance criteria and verified prerequisites absent
NEXT|implementation|BLOCKED UNTIL|behavioral acceptance criteria and verified prerequisites|requirements/planning

assertions.value: (?:^|\r?\n)READINESS\|order cancellation implementation\|NOT READY\|NOT AUTHORIZED\|behavioral acceptance criteria and verified prerequisites absent(?:\r?\n|$)
